data.title: [Party Together] - [Pastry Tower] Fest Event Details
data.brief: ▼// Event Time Asia Server: May 1, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenan
data.data:
▼// Event Time

Asia Server: May 1, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance on June 5, 2026 at 06:00

Americas / Europe Server: May 1, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance on June 4, 2026 at 17:00

· Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

· Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5


▼// Event Rewards

During the event, reach specified event points to unlock and claim the rewards: [Portrait: Fellow Travelers] and [Portrait: Festive Companions].


▼// Participation Requirements

After the Event Center is unlocked


▼// Event Details

· [Party Together] is divided into 2 phases. This event features Phase 1: [Pastry Tower].

· During [Pastry Tower], you can earn event points by stacking cakes.

· Once the required event points are reached, rewards will be sent to you via in-game mail. The mail will expire in 30 days, so please claim the rewards in time.


※ Phase 2 event [Gift Box Castell] will be available soon. Please keep an eye on the in-game Updates.

※ For more event details, please check the [Party Together] page.
